subject: general
question: If the angles P, Q and R of Δ PQR satisfy the relation 2R - P = Q - R, then find the measure of ∠R
solution:
**Given:**

 2R - P = Q - R

**Concept used:**

The sum of the angles of a triangle is 180° 

&l
t;strong>Calculation:

As per the question,

2R - P = Q - R

⇒ 3R = P+Q
